caption: The video captures a workshop scene dominated by green electrical cabinets marked with orange lightning stickers. In the foreground a polished steel hydraulic press ram stands vertically over a stepped die resting on a flat metal table. Its upper section is wrapped in a yellow-and-black hazard collar with a small side bolt. At the start, the die's top face is clean bare metal around the ram. Over time, small white flakes and chunks appear at the ram–die interface and slowly build up in a ring around the ram's base. Midway through, a sudden plume of white vapor erupts upward along the ram and sprays outward from the contact point between ram and die. After this burst, fine white particles streak through the air, drifting in front of the cabinets. A flattened white layer now coats the die's top surface around the ram. The background cabinets stay fixed while the ram and its collar sink toward the die. The process is still underway, with airborne specks continuing to fall and white material piled at the base.
